title: Collision Box
text: Create box collision geometry, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Enable Runtime Input Dimensions Error} sets the validation of collision box dimensions and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Length of box geometry along x -axis scalar

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Length of box geometry along y -axis scalar

ports.name: Z
ports.summary: Length of box geometry along z -axis scalar

ports.name: ExitFlag
ports.summary: Validity of collision box dimensions scalar

params.name: Enable Runtime Input Dimensions Error
params.values: Validation of collision box dimensions on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
